require "prism"
module MASTER::Stages
class Lint
FORBIDDEN = [
/system\(/,
/exec\(/,
/`.+`/, # backticks
/File\.delete/,
/rm -rf/
]
def self.call(ctx)
code = ctx.response
errors = []
# 1. Syntax check
result = Prism.parse(code)
unless result.success?
errors << "Syntax error"
end
# 2. Dangerous patterns
FORBIDDEN.each do |rule|
if code.match?(rule)
errors << "Forbidden pattern: #{rule}"
end
end
# 3. Basic sanity
if code.strip.empty?
errors << "Empty output"
end
if errors.any?
ctx.output = "Lint failed:\n#{errors.join("\n")}"
throw :halt
else
ctx.meta[:lint_passed] = true
end
end
end
end

module MASTER::Governance
class Council
MEMBERS = [
{ role: "safety", tier: :fast },
{ role: "correctness", tier: :fast },
{ role: "architecture", tier: :strong }
]
def self.vote(proposal:, ctx:)
votes = MEMBERS.map do |m|
prompt = <<~PROMPT
Role: #{m[:role]}
Evaluate this code change:
#{proposal}
Respond ONLY with: APPROVE or REJECT
PROMPT
res = LLM.call(prompt:, tier: m[:tier], ctx:)
normalize(res)
end
approve_count = votes.count { |v| v == :approve }
approve_count >= 2
end
def self.normalize(res)
res.upcase.include?("APPROVE") ? :approve : :reject
end
end
end
